name: agenda-mm
description: Sistema de Agenda, Notas Adhesivas y API Flask con Flutter APK

scripts.android:dev: powershell -Command "$dev = (adb get-serialno).Trim(); if ($dev -and $dev -ne 'unknown') { Set-Location agenda_app; flutter run -d $dev } else { Set-Location agenda_app; flutter run }"
scripts.android:release: powershell -Command "$dev = (adb get-serialno).Trim(); if ($dev -and $dev -ne 'unknown') { Set-Location agenda_app; flutter run --release -d $dev } else { Set-Location agenda_app; flutter run --release }"
scripts.android:install: powershell -Command "$dev = (adb get-serialno).Trim(); adb -s $dev install --user 0 -r agenda_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk; adb -s $dev shell am start -n com.alex.agendamm.agenda_app/.MainActivity"
scripts.android:install-release: powershell -Command "$dev = (adb get-serialno).Trim(); adb -s $dev install --user 0 -r agenda_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk; adb -s $dev shell am start -n com.alex.agendamm.agenda_app/.MainActivity"
scripts.backend:db:migrate: uv run flask --app backend.app db migrate --directory backend/migrations
scripts.backend:db:upgrade: uv run flask --app backend.app db upgrade --directory backend/migrations
